method: Every one of the ten original PNGs opened separately with view_image(detail=original); no contact-sheet-only review.

per_image.observations: Main-dialog bitmap contains all sections, legacy profile and bottom actions without clipping.
Main-dialog bitmap visibly disables legacy profile selection and shows calculation refusal; bottom actions visible.
Empty choices remain explicit; fields, explanatory text and footer actions are visible in this bitmap.
Both field columns and all footer actions are visible; longer execution labels can be read in the source pane.

FAIL: right-hand UK/project fields and the red explanatory line are cut off at the right image edge. Only the upper edges of footer buttons are visible at the bottom; button labels and usable action area are outside the bitmap.
Catalogue-revision mismatch and required explicit reselection are visible; footer actions remain visible.
Read-only state is visible; apply/clear are disabled and Close is visible.
Narrow-window view has an explicit content scrollbar; all three footer actions remain visible.
Scrolled narrow-window source view and its scrollbar remain visible; footer actions remain visible.
Scrolled source pane displays provenance and limitations; fixed footer actions remain visible.

findings.observed: Right-hand content is clipped; footer actions have no readable labels or usable visible button area.
findings.explanation: The manifest reports a 1100x800 client for a 1044x788 outer window and 1024x728 screen. Those inconsistent visible-size bases allowed the automated rectangle checks to pass while the captured result is clipped.
findings.required_followup: Constrain/reconcile actual window, client and rendered viewport after font scaling; validate footer controls against the actual visible form/screen rectangle and rerun native Windows UI plus independent review of every new PNG.

acceptance_boundary: Native WinForms bitmap review only. No AutoCAD host, native DWG transactions, Undo, save/reopen or engineering approval. Nine clean bitmaps do not override the blocking large-font failure.
